purpose: Segmented control with a sliding filled pill under the active/hovered tab. Real instance: the Type / Country switch of the pricing payment-method table.

items.note: Measured labels: Type, Country (1 word each). Only 2 tabs exist in the source.

states.hover: pill slides to hovered tab (200ms); mouse-out returns to active after 200ms
states.active: label colour switches to offWhite over the filled pill
states.narrow-viewport: below 700px (breakpoint.js-pricing-narrow) tabs scroll horizontally with scroll-snap and the active tab is centred

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule (no prefers-reduced-motion in the site): move the pill instantly (no width/translate transition).

responsive.below700px: container h-buttonLg, overflow-auto, snap-x mandatory, gap-5 between tabs, tabs px-4, rounded-mdu
responsive.from800px: container md:h-7, md:w-fit, tabs md:px-3 md:rounded-md, md:gap-1

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract

measuredFrom.quote: 'absolute left-0 top-0 h-full bg-current rounded-md transition-all duration-200'
Hover moves the pill to the hovered button; mouse-out snaps back to the active tab after 200ms.
